title: DATA SCIENTIST
description:
»

**Date:** 7 Oct 2026

**Location:** Gurgaon, KA, IN, 560038

**Company:** Hero Motocorp

**Function**
------------

Digital & Information Technologies

**Pay Band**
------------

E4 to M2

**Role**
--------

Data Scientist

**A purpose driven role for you**
---------------------------------

Support and drive the implementation of various AI use cases within the data science domain, collaborating with business teams to deliver end-to-end AI/ML solutions.

**A Day in the life**
---------------------

* Work with business teams to understand needs and convert them into useful AI/ML solutions.
* Assist in developing and testing machine learning models including Generative AI and Agentic AI.
* Help monitor and improve models after deployment.
* Develop in-depth understanding of business processes to advocate AI adoption for process efficiencies.
* Collaborate with vendor teams for AI projects to ensure high-impact delivery.

**Academic Qualification & Experience**
---------------------------------------

Academic Qualification: Master's from a Tier-1 college
  
Relevant Experience: Fresher

**Technical Skills/Knowledge**
------------------------------

* Programming & Tools: Python, SQL, Pandas, PySpark.
* Core Concepts: Statistics & Probability, Machine Learning (Supervised/Unsupervised).
* Advanced AI: Natural Language Processing (NLP), Generative AI, Agentic AI, LLM (OpenAI, LLama, RAG, Fine-tuning, Prompt Engineering).
* Data Engineering & Cloud: Snowflake, Delta Lake, GCP or equivalent cloud platform.

**Behavioural Skills**
----------------------

* Problem Solving Mind-set & Critical Thinking
* Adaptability and Agility
* Effective Communication and Collaboration skills

**What will it be like to work for Hero**
-----------------------------------------

As the **world’s largest** manufacturer of motorcycles and scooters for the last **25 years**, Hero is where you will get to work with the brightest innovators, passionate about being the best in what they do. You will become a part of India’s proudest legacy, a brand that is celebrated by **130 million Indians** and is now taking over the world with its manufacturing superpower.

If you are someone who dreams big and goes after their dreams with absolute conviction, Hero is your place to be. At Hero, we are building a cutting-edge future of mobility, pushing frontiers of innovation and aiming for the very best. **Choose to be with the best, choose to be your best.**

**About Hero**
--------------

Hero MotoCorp, headquartered in New Delhi, India, is the world's largest manufacturer of motorcycles and scooters for 25 consecutive years with ~$5 billion revenue. The Company's global footprint spans 52 countries across Asia, Africa, Europe, Central and Latin America with a customer base of over 130 million. The Company operates eight manufacturing facilities - six in India and one each in Colombia and Bangladesh- along with two Research and Development centres: Centre for Innovation and Technology (CIT) in India and Tech Centre Germany (TCG).
  
Hero MotoCorp is driving the transition to electric mobility through VIDA, powered by Hero.

Strategic alliances with Harley-Davidson and Zero Motorcycles support the design and development of premium and electric motorcycles, respectively. Further demonstrating its commitment to the EV future, the Company has made strategic investments in two- and three-wheeler EV manufacturers, Ather Energy and Euler Motors. Hero MotoCorp is the only Indian two-wheeler manufacturer listed on the prestigious Dow Jones Sustainability Index (D/SI).

Hero MotoCorp's Executive Chairman, Dr. Pawan Munjal, was named to the 2025 TIME100 Climate List of the 100 most influential leaders driving business climate action.

Beyond mobility, Hero MotoCorp is a major global promoter of sports, including golf, football, field hockey, and cricket. Hero MotoSports Team Rally is India's flag bearer in global rally racing.

**Job Segment:** Database, R&D Engineer, Scientific, SQL, R&D, Technology, Engineering, Research

title: Director, AI Solutions
description:
### **Responsibilities**

* Own the AI Solutions roadmap for the India delivery organization, setting the portfolio strategy, sequencing investments and prioritizing workstreams across Performance Improvement, Transaction Advisory, Office of the CFO and other practice lines
* Lead and develop a team of two to three Vice Presidents and their Senior Associates (approximately 10 to 15 professionals), providing strategic direction, technical guidance and career development
* Drive talent strategy for the AI Solutions function including hiring plans, role design, vendor partner selection and management and capability building across the team
* Partner with the India Delivery Leader and US-based Practice Line Leaders to translate firm priorities into a sequenced AI product portfolio with measurable business outcomes
* Oversee end-to-end delivery of agentic AI solutions and automation platforms across multiple concurrent workstreams, ensuring quality, reliability and on-time execution
* Establish and enforce engineering, governance and responsible AI standards across the function including prompt safety, data privacy, bias mitigation, model evaluation and MLOps practices
* Evaluate and select the AI tooling stack including LLM platforms, agentic frameworks, orchestration tools and AI coding tools (e.g., Claude Code), making build-versus-buy decisions
* Define and report on portfolio-level KPIs including adoption, productivity impact, ROI and quality and use those to reprioritize the roadmap
* Serve as the primary AI Solutions point of contact for senior firm stakeholders, representing the function in leadership forums and providing executive-ready updates
* Contribute selectively as a hands-on technical leader on flagship initiatives where senior judgment is required
* Lead firm-wide knowledge sharing, training and change management efforts to scale AI adoption across practice lines
* Support business development by shaping AI-related proposals, client presentations and solution demonstrations
* Support internal trainings and best practice sharing
* Support talent acquisition and firm-building initiatives
* Contribute to a high-performing, inclusive and values-driven culture

### **Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Data Science or a related technical field from a top undergraduate program; MBA or advanced degree strongly preferred
* Willing to relocate to or be primarily present in Gurgaon
* Ability to collaborate across global time zones, including US-based teams
* Ten to fifteen years of progressive experience in AI/ML, software engineering or related technical disciplines, with a meaningful portion of that experience in management consulting, professional services or private equity-backed advisory environments
* Demonstrated experience leading AI or technology functions of 10 or more professionals, including managing managers and developing senior individual contributors
* Proven track record setting product or portfolio roadmaps for AI, data or software functions and translating ambiguous business priorities into sequenced delivery plans
* Track record of building and scaling teams, including direct hiring leadership and experience managing vendor delivery partners
* Deep working knowledge of LLM-powered applications, agentic AI architectures, automation workflows and the modern AI tooling ecosystem (e.g., OpenAI, Claude, LangChain, N8N, Zapier or similar)
* Proficiency with AI coding tools such as Claude Code and the ability to engage credibly in technical reviews and architectural decisions
* Strong understanding of data engineering, model evaluation, MLOps and modern software development practices
* Demonstrated ability to establish and enforce responsible AI standards including bias detection, explainability and data privacy across production AI systems
* Experience operating in client-facing or executive-facing settings with the ability to shape AI-related proposals, presentations and senior stakeholder conversations
* Superior written and verbal communication skills, including executive-ready presentation and reporting skills
* Proven ability to thrive in lean, fast-moving teams
* High attention to detail, responsiveness and ownership mindset
* Track record of success in high-pressure environments
* Ability to convey technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders

* Translate business and finance questions into data\-driven insights in collaboration with cross\-functional stakeholders
* Support month\-end and year\-end closing activities with a focus on data accuracy and quality
* Conduct market, financial, and competitor analysis using quantitative and analytical methods
* Assist in audits and internal reviews by ensuring data consistency, traceability, and documentation
* Identify opportunities for process improvement through analytics, automation, and digital finance solutions

---------------------


* Bachelor’s degree in engineering
* Strong interest in finance and data analytics

* Working knowledge of Power BI, SQL, Python, or similar analytical tools
* Strong numerical reasoning, analytical mindset and problem\-solving skills
* High attention to detail with a structured and methodical approach to problem\-solving

description:

**Location:** Gurgaon, HR, IN, 122002


  
**Company:** Corning


  
Requisition Number: 78189

  

**The company built on breakthroughs.**  

**Join us.**

Corning is one of the world’s leading innovators in glass, ceramic, and materials science. From the depths of the ocean to the farthest reaches of space, our technologies push the boundaries of what’s possible.  



How do we do this? With our people. They break through limitations and expectations – not once in a career, but every day. They help move our company, and the world, forward.  



At Corning, there are endless possibilities for making an impact. You can help connect the unconnected, drive the future of automobiles, transform at\-home entertainment, and ensure the delivery of lifesaving medicines. And so much more.  



Come break through with us.

  

Corning’s businesses are ever\-evolving to best serve our customers, industries, and consumers. Today, we accelerate and transform life sciences, mobile consumer electronics, optical communications, display, automotive, and solar markets. We are changing the world with:


* Trusted products that accelerate drug discovery, development, and delivery to save lives
* Damage\-resistant cover glass to enhance the devices that keep us connected
* Optical fiber, wireless technologies, and connectivity solutions to carry information and ideas at the speed of light
* Precision glass for advanced displays to deliver richer experiences
* Auto glass and ceramics to drive cleaner, safer, and smarter transportation
* Solar polysilicon, wafers, and innovative photovoltaic modules, enabling low\-cost solar energy solutions
  

Company Overview Corning is a global leader in materials science, leveraging its expertise in specialty glass, ceramics, and optical physics to create innovative products that shape industries and improve lives. With over 170 years of innovation, Corning continues to invest in advanced analytics, data science, and Generative AI to enable enterprise\-wide digital transformation.


Position Summary


The Junior AI/ML Engineer – Generative AI Products is a role supporting Corning’s Enterprise Generative AI platform as well as AI/ML initiatives across the company. This position focuses on building, testing, and supporting data science and machine learning solutions, including forecasting models, analytics workflows, and Generative AI use cases, under the guidance of senior data scientists and engineers.


Responsibilities


* Support development and validation of machine learning and statistical models for business use cases


* Assist in building forecasting and predictive models using established techniques and libraries


* Contribute to Generative AI use cases including prompt development, evaluation, and basic experimentation with LLMs


* Support Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) workflows including document ingestion, embeddings, and retrieval


* Perform data preparation, feature engineering, and exploratory data analysis


* Work with structured and unstructured data from enterprise sources and AI platforms


* Collaborate with software engineers to integrate models into applications and pipelines


* Help document models, assumptions, results, and data pipelines


* Monitor model performance and assist with troubleshooting and improvements


* Participate in agile ceremonies including sprint planning, stand\-ups, and retrospectives


* Build scalable AI/ML models for given use cases, including price elasticity and recommendation systems, ensuring applicability/reusability across multiple business units.


* Leverage tools such as Databricks and AWS SageMaker to manage data, build models, and deploy solutions.


* Collaborate with stakeholders, understanding their needs and translating them into AI/ML solutions.


* Continually monitor and evaluate the effectiveness of AI/ML models and forecasting techniques, making necessary adjustments to optimize performance.


* Stay abreast of the latest AI/ML trends and technologies, identifying opportunities for innovation and improvement.

  

Education \& Experience


Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field. Typically requires 2–4 years of experience in data science, analytics, or machine learning roles, or equivalent academic and project experience.


Required Skills


* Proficiency in Python and familiarity with data science libraries (pandas, NumPy, scikit\-learn)


* Basic understanding of machine learning algorithms and statistical modeling techniques


* Experience working with SQL and relational or NoSQL databases


* Exposure to cloud or data platforms such as Databricks or AWS


* Familiarity with version control tools such as Git


* Ability to clearly communicate data insights and document work


* Experience working in agile or Scrum\-based teams


Desired Skills


* Exposure to Generative AI models or LLM APIs (e.g., OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic)


* Familiarity with time\-series forecasting methods (ARIMA, Prophet, or similar)


* Basic experience with vector databases or similarity search concepts


* Experience using notebook environments such as Jupyter


* Interest in enterprise AI platforms, data governance, and scalable solutions
